cards.title: Inbound lead qualifier
cards.desc: A form submission becomes an enriched, scored lead in the CRM, and the right rep gets a Slack message with the reason, all within 60 seconds.

cards.title: Account research brief
cards.desc: Paste a domain (or trigger from a new CRM company) and get a one-page brief: what they do, size, stack, recent news, hiring signals and three angles to open with.

cards.title: Outbound first-line writer
cards.desc: Upload or sync a lead list and get, per lead, a personal opening line plus the specific reason it is relevant, written to the sheet or sequencer.

cards.title: Pre-call brief
cards.desc: One hour before any external meeting, the rep gets a brief in Slack or email: who is attending, their roles, account history from the CRM, open deal status, last conversation summary and three suggested questions.

cards.title: Call to CRM
cards.desc: When a call recording is ready, the CRM gets a summary, next steps, updated deal fields and a drafted follow-up email waiting for the rep's approval.

cards.title: Stale deal nudger
cards.desc: Every weekday morning, each rep gets a short list of their deals that have gone quiet, with a specific suggested next action for each based on the deal's history.

cards.title: CRM hygiene
cards.desc: Every night the CRM is cleaned: duplicate contacts and companies merged or flagged, fields normalised (country, phone, title, industry), and records missing key data listed for owners.

cards.title: Champion job-change tracker
cards.desc: Watches your past champions and customers, and when one moves to a new company, creates a lead at the new company with context and alerts the account owner.

cards.title: Proposal generator
cards.desc: From a deal's fields and call notes, generates a branded proposal (scope, pricing table, timeline, terms), routes it for internal approval, then sends it for e-signature and updates the deal when signed.

cards.title: Reply classifier
cards.desc: Every reply to outbound email is classified (interested, not now, referral, unsubscribe, out of office, wrong person, bounce) and handled: interested replies go to the rep instantly, unsubscribes are honoured everywhere, out-of-office dates pause the sequence until the person returns.

cards.title: Website visitor to lead
cards.desc: Turns identified company visits to high-intent pages into account alerts and leads with the right contact suggested, so reps call the companies already reading the pricing page.

cards.title: Weekly pipeline digest
cards.desc: Every Monday, the team gets a digest: pipeline created, moved, won and lost, coverage against target, slipping deals, and the three things worth discussing in the pipeline meeting.

cards.title: Account research
cards.desc: Given a company domain (and optionally a person and a goal for the meeting), researches the account across the web and the buyer's CRM and returns a cited brief with angles to open with.

cards.title: Inbound qualifier
cards.desc: Qualifies an inbound lead end to end: validates, enriches, scores against the ICP with explainable reasons, assigns an owner and drafts the first touch, then asks for approval before writing to the CRM or messaging anyone.

cards.title: Outbound personaliser
cards.desc: For each lead in a list, finds one genuine, verifiable reason to reach out and writes a first line and a short email that uses it, refusing to fake familiarity.

cards.title: Meeting prep and follow-up
cards.desc: Before a meeting, writes the brief; after it, turns the transcript into a summary, CRM updates and a follow-up email draft, all waiting for the rep's approval.

cards.title: CRM hygiene
cards.desc: Audits a CRM slice for duplicates, bad formats and missing data, proposes a patch plan with reasons, and applies approved changes safely in batches.

cards.title: Proposal drafter
cards.desc: Drafts a proposal for a deal: narrative from call notes, pricing computed by tools (never by the model), timeline and terms from templates, then routes for approval and e-signature.

cards.title: RFP responder
cards.desc: Answers security questionnaires and RFPs from an approved answer library and product docs, with citations, confidence per answer and a list of questions that need an expert.

cards.title: Objection coach
cards.desc: Gives reps grounded responses to objections (price, timing, competitor, security) using the buyer's battlecards, win stories and call history, in a quick chat or after a call.

cards.title: Territory planner
cards.desc: Proposes balanced territories and account assignments from accounts, rep capacity and constraints, explaining trade-offs, as a plan the sales leader approves.

cards.title: Win-loss analyst
cards.desc: Analyses closed deals (notes, call transcripts, loss reasons) and produces win-loss themes with evidence and recommendations each quarter.

cards.title: Ticket triage
cards.desc: Every new ticket gets category, priority, language, sentiment and intent set within seconds, is routed to the right team or person, and urgent ones page the on-call lead.

cards.title: Grounded reply drafts with approval
cards.desc: For each triaged ticket in an eligible category, drafts a reply grounded only in the knowledge base and policies, with citations and a confidence score, and puts it in front of an agent to approve, edit or reject.

cards.title: Refund and return handler
cards.desc: Refund and return requests are checked against policy and order data, a recommended decision is prepared with the math, and an approver executes it in one click.

cards.title: Support QA scorer
cards.desc: Each week, samples closed tickets per agent and scores them against your QA rubric (accuracy, tone, resolution, policy), with coaching notes, so leads review 5 flagged tickets instead of 50 random ones.

cards.title: Churn signal detector
cards.desc: Combines negative ticket sentiment, usage drops, failed payments and cancellation language into one risk score per account and alerts the owner with the evidence and a suggested save play.

cards.title: Knowledge base gap finder
cards.desc: Finds questions customers keep asking that the knowledge base does not answer, clusters them, and drafts new articles for review.

cards.title: Bug report to issue
cards.desc: Support tickets that report bugs become clean engineering issues in Linear or Jira, deduplicated against open issues, with steps to reproduce, environment and affected customers, and the ticket is linked so support hears when it ships.

cards.title: CSAT and NPS theme analysis
cards.desc: Weekly, groups CSAT and NPS comments into themes with counts, trends and example quotes, so product and support see what is driving scores.

cards.title: Onboarding check-ins from product events
cards.desc: New accounts get timely, specific check-ins based on what they have and have not done in the product (not a fixed drip), and stuck accounts are flagged to their CSM.

cards.title: SLA breach early warning
cards.desc: Warns the team before tickets breach SLA: at 75% of the time budget the assignee is pinged, at 90% the lead, with a single view of everything at risk.

cards.title: Multilingual reply layer
cards.desc: Agents read every ticket in their language and reply in their language; the customer receives a natural reply in theirs, with a glossary that keeps product terms consistent.

cards.title: Weekly support operations report
cards.desc: Every Monday: volume, backlog, first response and resolution times, SLA attainment, CSAT, top categories and what changed, per team.

cards.title: Ticket triage
cards.desc: Triages a ticket fully: cleans it, detects language, looks up the customer, classifies category, intent, sentiment and priority with reasons, and routes it, applying writes after approval or by policy.

cards.title: Grounded answer agent with citations
cards.desc: Answers customer questions only from the knowledge base and policies, with sentence-level citations, and says clearly when the answer is not in the sources.

cards.title: Refund decision agent with approval
cards.desc: Evaluates a refund or return request against policy and order data, computes the eligible amount with a tool, drafts the customer reply, and executes only after a human approves.

cards.title: Support QA reviewer
cards.desc: Scores closed conversations against the team's QA rubric with evidence quotes and coaching notes, calibrated to human graders.

cards.title: Churn risk watcher
cards.desc: Watches support, usage and billing signals, explains which accounts are at risk and why, and proposes a save play for the owner.

cards.title: Docs gap finder
cards.desc: Finds what customers ask that the docs do not answer, clusters it, and drafts the missing articles from the best agent replies.

cards.title: Voice of customer analyst
cards.desc: Answers 'what are customers telling us' across tickets, surveys, reviews and calls, with themes, trends and quotes, for any segment and period.

cards.title: Macro writer
cards.desc: Finds repetitive replies in solved tickets and proposes reusable macros with variables, linked to the KB, for the team to approve.

cards.title: Escalation summariser
cards.desc: When a ticket escalates to engineering or management, writes a crisp summary: customer, impact, timeline, what was tried, open questions and the ask.

cards.title: Onboarding coach
cards.desc: Guides new customers through setup based on what they have done, answering questions in-app or by email with links to the exact next step.
